purpose: Temporarily put a topic aside to focus on another.
keywords: N + はさておき; question clause + はさておき
Joking aside, let’s decide the schedule.
Putting price aside, I want to compare ease of use.
Leaving aside whether we can win, let’s take part.
formation: N + はさておき; question clause + はさておき
restrictions: Often shifts from evaluation to a more immediate matter.
mistake: It postpones consideration, rather than proving the topic irrelevant forever.
